summary_1line: Shatrughna, moved by the epic at Valmiki’s hermitage, returns to Ayodhya, reports Lavana’s defeat, and reluctantly agrees to keep ruling his own kingdom.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shatrughna stands before Rama in Ayodhya’s court, bowing with joined palms as the moon-faced king sits surrounded by counselors.
Valmiki embraces Shatrughna in the forest hermitage as the prince prepares to depart on a magnificent chariot at dawn.
Shatrughna tearfully pleads before Rama, comparing himself to a calf separated from its mother after twelve years away.
